Name: ReMapping Old - 1.5 Only
Author: Vlgor
Description:
[center][color=#f4f4f4][size=4][b]The [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29049]New Version (1.6)[/url]﻿ of the mod is available separately[/b][/size][/color][color=#f4f4f4][size=4][b]

[/b][/size][/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29049][size=4][img]https://i.imgur.com/9ncrPhb.png[/img][/size][/url][font=Trebuchet MS][size=5][b]___[/b][/size][/font][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][size=6][b][size=3][size=5][b]________________________________________________________[/b][/size][/size][size=3]﻿﻿[/size][/b][/size][color=#e69138][size=6][b]
[/b][/size][/color][/font][/size]
﻿[size=5][b]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/WGjJU7Y.png[/img][/b][/size][/center][spoiler]
[center][b][size=3][size=4][font=Trebuchet MS]Este mod proporciona a experiência de visualizar no minimapa outros mods que adicionam estruturas à cidade, e que não possuem esse recurso em seus próprios arquivos[/font][/size][/size][/b][size=3][b][size=2]

﻿﻿[/size][/b][font=Times New Roman][size=4]﻿﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/106092643][img]https://i.imgur.com/7XPUUYa.png[/img][/url]﻿﻿
Um agradecimento muito especial para o [size=3][size=4][size=3][font=Times New Roman][size=4][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/106092643]Kiyugamods[/url][/i][/size][/font][/size][/size][/size], que não apenas me ajudou a criar este mod,
mas também teve uma enorme dedicação em garantir que ele fosse lançado o mais rápido possível[/size][/font]
[size=5][b]_______________________________________________________[/b][/size][/size][size=3]﻿﻿[font=Trebuchet MS][color=#e69138][size=6][b]

Como Instalar[/b][/size][/color][/font][b]
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]
[/size][/font][/b][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][b]1.[/b] Baixe o [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[b]2.[/b] Coloque o arquivo do ReMappin na pasta Mods
[color=#f4f4f4][b]3.[/b][/color] E pronto! Ele já está instalado.[/size][/font][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]
[/font][font=Trebuchet MS]-------------------------------------------------------
[b]4.[/b] Para que o seu mod apareça no mapa,
você também terá que tê-lo instalado em seu modpack.
Veja a lista de compatibilidade abaixo[/font][/size][b][size=3]
[/size]


[font=Trebuchet MS][color=#f4f4f4][size=6]Descrições & Detalhes[/size][/color][/font][size=4]

[/size][/b][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]Ao adicionar o Remapping ao seu modpack, ele reconhecerá os mods compatíveis e adicionará as suas estruturas ao mapa.
O mod pode ser[color=#f6b26b] adicionado[/color] ou[color=#f6b26b] desinstalado[/color] a qualquer momento no jogo sem afetar de nem uma forma o seu save.
Sugestões para adicionar[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3] mods[/size][/font][/size] são sempre bem-vindas.[/size][/font][font=Trebuchet MS][b][size=4]
[/size][/b][size=3][b]
Ele funciona com os principais mods que alteram o mapa geral, como o [color=#e69138]Stardew Valley Expanded[/color] (SVE)
[size=3][size=4][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b][size=4][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]([color=#f6b26b]Immersive[/color] and [color=#f6b26b]Grandpa[/color] farm); [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4120]Boarding House[/url]; [color=#e69138]East Scarp[/color];[/size][/font] [font=Trebuchet MS][color=#e69138][size=3]NCP Location[/size][/color][/font];[/size][/b][/font][/size][/size][/size]
[/b]No entanto, ainda [u]não[/u] funciona com outros mods de [u]texturas personalizadas[/u].[/size][b][size=4]

[/size][/b][size=4]
O número de mods adicionados é bastante extenso, e para os [size=3][size=4][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][size=4][color=#f6b26b]modders[/color][/size][/font][/size][/size][/size] que chegaram até aqui
e encontraram seu na lista, e que se sentiram desconfortáveis comigo usando os seus nomes,
por favor, sintam-se à vontade para entrar em contato comigo caso deseja que eu o remova das compatibilidades.

[/size][u][size=4]A lista abaixo exibe todos os mods que o Remapping adiciona no mapa:[/size][/u][/font][/size][size=3] [/size]
[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][/size][/font][/size][/center][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]
[/size][/font][/size][font=Trebuchet MS][size=4][/spoiler][/size][/font][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][size=4][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][size=4]- PT[/size][/font][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][size=4]-BR[/size][/font][/size][/size][/font][/size]
[/size][/font][center][b][font=Trebuchet MS][size=4]﻿This mod provides the experience of visualizing other mods that add structures
to the city but don't appear on the [color=#f4f4f4]minimap[/color].[/size][/font][size=2]

﻿﻿﻿[size=3][font=Times New Roman][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/106092643][img]https://i.imgur.com/7XPUUYa.png[/img][/url][/size][/font][/size]
[/size][/b][font=Times New Roman][size=4][i]A very special thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/106092643]Kiyugamods[/url], [/i][/size][/font][font=Times New Roman][size=4]who not only helped me create this mod
but also for their dedication to ensuring that this mod was released as quickly as possible.[/size][/font]
[size=5][b]_______________________________________________________[/b][/size][/center][center]﻿﻿[font=Trebuchet MS][color=#e69138][size=6][b]
To Install[/b][/size][/color][/font][b]
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]
[/size][/font][/b][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][b]1.[/b] Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[b]2.[/b] Put the ReMappin file in the Mods folder
[color=#f4f4f4][b]3.[/b][/color] There you go! Mod installed[/size][/font][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS].
[/font][font=Trebuchet MS]-------------------------------------------------------
[b]4.[/b] For your mod to appear, you also need to have it in your mod pack.
See the list below.[/font][/size][b][size=3]
[/size]


[font=Trebuchet MS][color=#f4f4f4][size=6]Descriptions & Details[/size][/color][/font][size=4]

[/size][/b][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]By adding Remapping to your mod pack, it will recognize compatible mods and add their structures to the map.
The mod can be [color=#f6b26b]added[/color] or [color=#f6b26b]uninstalledat[/color] any time in the game without affecting your save in any way.[/size][/font][font=Trebuchet MS][b][size=4]
[/size][/b][size=3]Suggestions for mods to add are always welcome.[/size][b][size=4]
[/size][/b][size=3][b]
It works with the main mods that alter the overall map[/b][/size][size=4][b],[/b][/size][b][size=4][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][color=#e69138] Stardew Valley Expanded [/color](SVE)
([color=#f6b26b]Immersive[/color] and [color=#f6b26b]Grandpa[/color] farm); [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4120]Boarding House[/url]; [color=#e69138]East Scarp[/color];[/size][/font] [font=Trebuchet MS][color=#e69138][size=3]NCP Location[/size][/color][/font];
[/size][/b][size=3]However, it still [u]doesn't[/u] work with [u]custom texture mods[/u].[/size][b][size=4]


[/size][/b][size=4]The number of added mods is quite extensive, and for the [color=#f6b26b]modders[/color] who have come across here
and found their mod in the list, and have felt uncomfortable with me using their name,
please feel free to contact me if you wish for me to remove it.

[/size][u][size=4]The list below displays all the mods that ReMapping adds to the map:[/size][/u][size=3]

Warning!

Compatible Version Only with Stardew Valley 1.5 or Lower.
⭐ If You Are Using Version 1.6, Download the New Version Available Separately ⭐

When it detects a compatible mod, it adds it to the minimap. Otherwise, it will remain inactive.
